name: CEIO
title: CEIO: A Cache-Efficient Network I/O Architecture for NIC-CPU Data Paths

summary: 接收NIC按LLC credit分流到主机快路径与NIC DRAM慢路径，改善缓存争用下尾延迟，但增加基本WRITE延迟和缓冲管理成本。
